items.title: Tyler Allgeier: Not much on five touches in Week 10
items.text:
Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Seth McGowan: Retains expanded role Sunday
items.text:
McGowan rushed 12 times for 77 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 61 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tony Pollard: Finds end zone in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Pollard carried the ball nine times for 33 yards and caught eight of nine targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Gets 13 touches Sunday
items.text:
Jeanty turned his nine carries into just 18 yards and caught all four of his targets for 46 yards during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Washington: Tallies 120 all-purpose yards in loss
items.text:
Washington secured all three targets for 50 yards, threw a 34-yard touchdown on his one pass attempt and returned four punts for 36 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Ward: Produces two TDs in loss to Jags
items.text:
Ward completed 28 of 39 passes for 231 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
